details:
I always enjoy VRChat thanks to VRC+.

I’m emailing you with some feedback and requests.

As a user, I appreciate that VRC+ offers certain features for free, but I do think making everything free is taking it too far.

I believe VRC+ should establish a clearer distinction between its subscription users and non-subscribers.

For example, currently, there are no limits on avatar uploads. However, VRC+ users should be allowed unlimited avatar uploads, while non-subscribers should have a cap on both the number of avatars they can upload and the number of characters they can use.

Setting a limit of 20 to 40 characters would also help reduce the load on the servers.

Besides, since most users upload 10 or fewer avatars, I don’t think implementing this would be a problem.

For instance, you could prioritize VRC+ users when allowing entry into worlds during peak times.

Especially when event worlds in Japan get crowded, VRChat as a whole tends to become very laggy, so please consider this.

In short, I’d like to see more benefits given to subscription users in areas that place a heavy load on the servers.

I’d like certain features to remain VRC+ exclusive permanently.

I also think it would be great to have VRC+ exclusive item sales or occasional giveaways for VRC+ users.

I’d like to see VRC+’s added value clearly differentiated even more.
title: VRC+ Requests
